facts.fact: Intraday agent evaluation runs on the Vercel cron schedule "*/15 13,14,15,16,17,18,19,20,21 * * 1-5" (UTC), i.e. every 15 minutes, weekdays, 13:00–21:45 UTC.
facts.notes: Both DST arms are covered by the UTC hour span; evaluation is additionally gated by isMarketOpen() (ET 09:30–16:00 / 13:00 early close). Crypto-extended battles (expiresAt 20:00 ET) are only expiry-completed on the next cron arm or by the decide.js GC path.

facts.fact: The only pickup filter for evaluation is agentBattles.status == "active" (findActiveAgentBattles).
Expiry completion runs on every cron tick regardless of market hours; scoring/evaluation runs only when isMarketOpen() is true.

Battle duration mode is a hard-coded constant AGENT_BATTLE_DURATION_MODE = "fullday": one trading day, expiring at the next market close (16:00 ET; 13:00 ET early close; 20:00 ET when the portfolio holds crypto). The legacy multi-day ("1d"/"3d"/"5d") branch is dead code.

createAgentBattle JSDoc still documents duration 1d|3d|5d options

facts.fact: Battle creation happens only in createAgentBattle (fenced), called from two paths in api/agent/decide.js: the self-select tiered deploy (Sonnet strategy + Haiku portfolio) and the prescribed flat6 tournament deploy (no model calls).

A battle is created ACTIVE immediately at deploy (status:"active", activatedAt = createdAt = now); there is no separate start condition and no market-hours gate on creation. If created outside market hours, the expiry targets the next trading day close.

The clock source is server wall-clock converted to America/New_York via Intl (getETDate); expiresAt is stored as a UTC ISO string; timing.tradingDays is an array of ET date strings; timing.localOpen "09:30" and localClose "16:00"/"13:00"/"20:00".

One active battle per agentId is enforced at deploy (query agentBattles where agentId==X and status=="active" limit 1); an expired "active" battle is GC-completed with a bare 3-field write {status:"completed", completedAt, completionReason:"expired"}.
facts.symbol: GC update :764-768 (self-select) and :1388-1392 (tournament); one-active-battle query precedes each
facts.notes: The bare GC completion is later repaired by repairBareGcCompletions (agent-evaluate.js) which re-tags completionReason to "expired_repaired".

facts.fact: Recurring evaluation per battle: every cron tick (15 min) the battle is scored; the model (Haiku) is called only when the trigger gate fires (first eval forced, FINAL_HOUR forced, otherwise conditional triggers) — so decision cadence is event-conditional, not fixed.

Agent action opportunities per evaluation: at most ONE model-decided SWAP (one slot replaced by one bench/hotBench candidate) or HOLD; deterministic risk-manager and guardrail swaps can additionally fire in the same tick, each also one slot per firing.

Ending condition: expiresAt < now, detected by the cron expiry loop (any tick, market open or not) or by the decide.js GC on the agent's next deploy. Completion is a guarded Firestore transaction (completeBattle) that writes status:"completed", completedAt, pendingReflection, reviewPending, statusFeed entry, and (tiered only) agent W/L/streak stats.

Forced settlement is implicit: positions are NOT liquidated at expiry. Final score = scoreState.currentScore as last written by the last evaluation tick (activeScore + bankedScore + bankedBadgePoints); no closing valuation is recomputed at completion.
facts.symbol: completeBattle reads fresh.scoreState.currentScore (inside the transaction, ~:4300); no price fetch in completeBattle
facts.notes: The last scoring write happens on the last market-open tick before expiresAt (e.g. 15:45 ET for a 16:00 close). Prices used are the delayed REST quote at that tick.

facts.fact: Tie handling: tiered battles compare currentScore vs opponentScore; equal scores yield result "draw" (streak reset to 0). Tournament (flat6) battles have no W/L result (result:null, completionContext "tournament_group_scored").
No paused/cancelled state exists for agentBattles; states are active → completed only (plus tournament group states forming/drafting/awaiting_open/battle/complete/expired/voided at the group level).
facts.notes: Voiding is a tournamentGroups-level disposition (voidGroup), not an agentBattles state.

facts.fact: Platform-forced actions on a battle: (1) risk-manager exits (bust_avoidance, vwap_failure, stepped_trail, stagnation forced rotation); (2) guardrail forced exits (stopLoss, trailingStop, profitTarget) and sector-cap blocks; (3) LOCK (near bonus threshold) blocking model swaps; (4) model SWAP downgraded to HOLD by validation, hurdle floor, swap-window cap, distressed-regime block, or reserve failure; (5) daily banking reset at 01:45 UTC.

An agent can act until the last market-open tick before close (FINAL_HOUR forces a model evaluation when 0<minutesUntilClose<=60 on the last trading day); there is no explicit no-trade cutoff before expiry.

Timestamps persisted on the battle doc: createdAt, activatedAt, expiresAt, completedAt, updatedAt (ISO strings); cronState.lastEvaluatedAt/lastTriggeredAt/lastEvalStartedAt/evaluatingAt; scoreState.lastScoredAt/peakScoreAt; timing.lastDailyResetAt; per-evaluation timestamp; per-trade swappedOutAt/swappedInAt; statusFeed[].timestamp.

Nightly badge banking: agent-daily-scores cron ("45 1 * * 2-6" UTC = 8:45 PM ET Mon–Fri) banks bonusPoints into scoreState.bankedBadgePoints, resets thresholdHistory, clears swapPrice/swappedInDay, and bumps timing.currentTradingDay. For fullday battles this normally runs after expiry (16:00 ET) and only matters for still-active (crypto 20:00 ET) battles.

facts.fact: Cash is not represented: a battle is a fixed set of slots (tiered 2 star / 2 core / 3 support incl. 1 mandatory crypto = 7; flat6 = 6 stocks); every slot is always filled (a forced exit with no replacement DEFERS rather than emptying the slot). There is no cash position, no leverage, no dollar sizing.

Position sizing is slot-based, not dollar-based: score contribution = priceChange% × 10 × tierMultiplier (star 2.0, core 1.5, support 1.0; flat6 all 1.0) plus flat badge points at ATR-multiple thresholds (+15/+30/+50, −10/−20/−35). "Exposure" is therefore a slot label, not a weight; fractional exposure does not exist.

Per-position and portfolio limits: fixed slot count (7 tiered / 6 flat6); crypto only in support[2] (tiered) and bench.crypto; stock↔stock and crypto↔crypto swaps only; no duplicate symbol across slots; no self-swap; 24h bench cooldown on swapped-out assets.

Sector/category constraints: (1) user-equipped maxSectorWeight guardrail evaluated by slot-count share on the projected post-swap book (tiered denominator = held count; tournament denominator = 6); (2) Diversifier flat6 sector-slot cap derived from sectorConcentrationCap=2 (33.3%) — currently SECTOR_CAP_MODE="observe" (measured, never enforced); (3) prompt-level sector awareness prose (non-binding).
Positions can only be REPLACED one-for-one (SWAP symbolOut→symbolIn in the same slot). Increase, reduce, or reverse are not expressible in the tool schema (decision enum HOLD|SWAP).

Archetype physics knobs (hftConfig) are archetype-locked and version-stamped (KNOB_CONFIG_VERSION=2): forced rotation (stagnation) thresholds, hurdle floor ATR-margin per reason (0.2–0.5 ATR), swap-window circuit breaker (cap 2–12 per 60–120 min). Guardian has forced rotation disabled.

Base risk levers come from the battle strategyPreset (always "balanced" at creation; client-editable via rules allowlist): bustBuffer −0.85 ATR, vwapFailureTicks 2, vwapDeadBandPct 0.5, trailStopATR 1.5. Model conviction floor for SWAP is 70 (hard, validateTradeDecision).

The tempo dial (TEMPO_DIAL_ENABLED=true) scales the knob capacity/resistance fields by 0.7/1.0/1.3 (measured/standard/aggressive) and is fail-closed to "standard" if TEMPO_DIAL_BANDS.forKnobConfigVersion (2) ≠ KNOB_CONFIG_VERSION; provenance is stamped on each swap (swapProvenance).

A CPU opponent portfolio is embedded in every tiered battle (generateCPUOpponent: Math.random sector picks + random crypto), scored passively with frozen startingPrices; tournament battles have no embedded opponent.

facts.fact: Intraday model call: exactly one anthropic.messages.create per battle per triggered tick — model EVAL_MODEL_ID="claude-haiku-4-5-20251001", max_tokens 2048, temperature 0.4, system prompt + 2-turn messages (identity block / canned assistant ack / live context), forced tool submit_trade_decision, SDK timeout 20s, hard abort 22s, maxRetries 0.

Model inputs assembled per tick: system prompt (mode variant tiered/flat6 + DR-13 archetype identity block + framework prose gated by PROFIT_TARGET_EXECUTOR_ENABLED / EQUIPPED_RULE_PRECEDENCE_ENABLED); identity block (agentContext: name, archetype, risk tolerance, strategy brief, initial rationale, consolidatedInsight, Forge rules C/S with hardness); live context (score header, phase/time remaining, macro SPY/QQQ/BTC %, vision block, regime context, preset guidance, ACTIVE POSITIONS CSV, BENCH CSV, bench technicals, fundamentals block, closed trades with ghost prices, triggers, intraday momentum, risk status, directive/leans blocks, institutional block, news (≤3 ranked stories or bare headlines), last 3 evaluations).
Prior reasoning shown to the model is limited to the last 3 evaluation entries, truncated (rationale 80 chars, hypothesis 60 chars), plus the closed-trades table; full history is not replayed.

Structured output expected: submit_trade_decision {decision HOLD|SWAP, symbolOut, symbolIn, swap_type, rationale, hypothesis, conviction 0-100, riskAssessment, ignoredDirectiveIds, directiveThreadId, status_feed_update, trade_reasoning{thesis,strategy,indicators,citedRules,conviction}, pvp_context, cited_rules, cited_forge_rules, overridden_forge_rules, anticipationCandidates[]}.

Parsing: the first tool_use block's input is taken as haikuResult only if typeof input.decision === "string"; otherwise the tick is classified truncated_response and defaults to HOLD. No JSON schema validation beyond the API's tool schema; no retries (maxRetries 0; founder decision L2 "measure first").

Fallback on model failure/timeout/budget skip: decision = HOLD, haikuError recorded on the evaluation entry, cronState.consecutiveEvalFailures incremented (except budget_skipped), eval_degraded statusFeed entry written.

Meaning-transforming boundaries between model output and applied action, in order: (1) applyGuardrails may REWRITE the decision to a forced SWAP (different symbols, synthetic rationale/hypothesis, conviction max(orig,70)) or block to HOLD; (2) LOCK block; (3) distressed-regime swap-in block; (4) validateTradeDecision (symbol resolution, cooldown, asset-type match, conviction≥70, hypothesis≥10 chars); (5) hurdle floor (archetype ATR margin + bench-positive rule); (6) swap-window cap; (7) tournament reserve; (8) executeSwapServer transaction may throw (slot changed, duplicate, no price). Each downgrade appends validationErrors and sets downgraded=true.

The model's free-text rationale is persisted on the evaluation entry (rationale, hypothesis, trade_reasoning, cited rules) and copied onto the trade record on SWAP; on a guardrail-forced swap the persisted rationale is the SYNTHETIC guardrail string, and the model's original text for that tick is lost from the entry (only evaluation.guardrailOverrides/originalDecision and shadowTerminalGates.proposedAction retain traces).

Decision acceptance and application are the same tick: an accepted SWAP is executed immediately inside executeSwapServer (autopilot); copilot/manual proposal modes exist in code but are unreachable (LAUNCH GUARD forces autopilot).

facts.fact: No first-class orders exist on the agent path: a decision is applied as an atomic Firestore transaction (executeSwapServer) that rewrites the portfolio slot, appends a closed-trade record, moves the outgoing asset to the bench with a 24h cooldown, and increments tradeCount. Only "market-at-current-quote" semantics exist; no order types.

Execution price: for both legs getPrice(symbol) = livePriceBeacon (if written <2 min ago) else currentPrices[symbol].current, where current is the EODHD /real-time close field fetched at tick start (forceRefresh). The beacon is never written in production (client writer removed 2026-07-16; rules allowlist excludes it), so the REST quote is the effective fill price.

facts.fact: Fill semantics: immediate, full-slot, at the quote; exitPrice defaults to entryPrice if no quote (locking 0 points); swap-in throws if no valid price (swap aborted, decision downgraded to HOLD).

Costs: zero. No slippage, no spread, no fees, no borrow — agent-battle P&L is pure quote-to-quote points. (Contrast: the separate mandate engine applies cap-tier slippage+spread bps with $0 commission.)

facts.fact: Timing of execution: within the same cron invocation as the decision, typically seconds after the quote fetch; the quote itself is the value EODHD returned at tick start (not re-fetched at execution, except proposal paths and Guard-3 daily reference).
facts.symbol: prices fetch :703-717 (:710); executeSwapServer call :2335 (same prices object)

facts.fact: Rejection/failure handling: validation failures downgrade to HOLD with validationErrors; execution throws are caught, downgrade to HOLD, release any tournament reservation, and write "Swap execution failed" into validationErrors; risk-swap failures write a risk_swap_failed feed entry. No retry of a failed execution within the tick.

Unavailable-symbol behavior: if any HELD symbol lacks a usable quote (missing/NaN/≤0/fallback:true), the whole battle tick is skipped (M1 guard) preserving prior scoreState; bench/hotBench symbols without quotes simply score as 0 daily change and cannot be swapped in (no price → throw).

Concurrency: per-battle evaluatingAt lock (120s TTL) acquired in a transaction; the cron is single-invocation with a 290s budget and fair-rotation ordering; two-phase reserve/confirm ledger for tournament symbol exclusivity; swap transactions re-read the slot at commit time.

Determinism after decision: given the same prices object and battle doc, execution is deterministic (pure scoring math, no randomness); non-determinism enters only via the quote fetched at tick start and the Firestore transaction retry re-read.

There is no realistic execution model on the agent path: no liquidity/capacity constraint, no partial fills, no market-impact, and the fill price is a delayed consolidated quote. This is stated in-code as a deliberate product decision ("uniform (delayed) REST pricing for all agents is safe, consistent, and fair").

The only price/history provider in executable code is EODHD (API_BASE https://eodhd.com/api, key EODHD_API_KEY). No Finnhub/CoinGecko/Polygon/Alpaca/Yahoo price code exists at HEAD (CoinGecko maps in src/services/eodhdAPI.js are empty deprecated shims).

Agent "current price" = EODHD /real-time/{SYM}.US "close" field (fallback previousClose, then 0), fetched fresh (uncached) at every tick for every held/bench/hotBench/CPU/macro symbol; changePercent = EODHD change_p. On fetch failure the price object is the last daily close tagged fallback:true, which the settlement guard rejects.

Quote delay is asserted only by comments ("15-min delayed" at agentSwapExecution.js:180, AgentBattleScreen.jsx:783, eod-close.js:3); no constant, no runtime measurement, no vendor doc in-repo. The actual delay of the EODHD real-time endpoint for the subscribed plan is UNKNOWN from code.

agentBattles/{id}/shadowDiffs/{cronStartIso_battleId}: one create-only doc per evaluated tick for manifest-bearing battles when SHADOW_ASSEMBLY_ENABLED — envelope (manifestId/hash, version stamps, effectiveRuntimeResolution incl. modelId and commitSha), prompt hashes and sizes for the re-derived system/identity/context prompts, full texts only on live-vs-shadow divergence. battleSettlements/{battleId}: create-only settlement record at completion. Both client-denied by the rules catch-all (no explicit rules block).

Market-intelligence docs read by the agent path (server-written, client-readable): indexIntelligence/stockRankings (stocks[] with baggerBombFit, atrPercentile, technicalScore, fundamentalScore, sectorName, levels, fundamentals mirror; mode premarket|intraday; computedAt; expiresAt), indexIntelligence/marketContext (regime, volatilityRegime), indexIntelligence/SPY, indexIntelligence/dailyRegimeBrief, stockTechnicalScores/{sym} (factors, atrPercent, updatedAt), fantasyTimesStories, voiceLayerCache/{battleId}.

facts.fact: Per decided tick the battle doc persists an evaluations[] entry (cap 150) with: evalId, timestamp, day, battlePhase, decision, symbolOut/In and tier (only when SWAP/PROPOSAL), rationale, hypothesis, conviction, riskAssessment, ignoredDirectiveIds, directiveThreadId, trade_reasoning, cited/overridden Forge rules, triggers, scores, validationErrors, downgraded, marketPosture, guardrailOverrides, guardrailSourceNote, haikuError, plus (TICK_STAMPS_ENABLED) heard, evidence (held positions only: px, chg, atrX, vwapDev, bbPct, nr7, regime, risk), vintages, candidates.

Per executed swap the battle doc persists a trades[] entry (cap 50): symbols, tier/slot, entryPrice, exitPrice, lockedPoints, lockedGainPct, swappedOutAt, swapDay, isCrypto, direction, id, trigger, rationale, hypothesis, evaluationId, tradingDay, entryRegime, entryMarketPosture, entryConviction, entryPreset, entryMode, exitReason, swapMotive, source, archetype, hftKnobsSource, swapProvenance{tempo,dialBandVersion,knobConfigVersion}, trade_reasoning, and snapshot{symbolOut,symbolIn} (full technical snapshot of both legs incl. intraday vwap/currentPrice).

NOT persisted anywhere: the exact system/identity/context prompt strings sent to the model; the raw model response; the verbatim tool-call JSON (only ~12 hand-picked properties are copied); the full prices table the model saw (bench/hotBench/macro); the candidate menu at an arbitrary tick (watchlist is written only on rebuild ticks; shadowGateAggregates stores a COUNT); deploy-time retry request/response and validation error strings; per-tick token counts (only running totals on cronState; per-tick counts go to the fire-and-forget GCS stream).

facts.fact: Model identity per decision is persisted ONLY inside the shadow envelope (effectiveRuntimeResolution.modelId, commitSha, promptSpecVersion, knobConfigVersion, guardrailSetVersion, calibrationBundleVersion) on shadowDiffs docs and shadowGateAggregates/shadowTerminalGates entries — gated on SHADOW_ASSEMBLY_ENABLED=true AND a resolvedAgentManifest on the battle. The evaluations[] entry itself carries no model id or prompt version.

On a guardrail-forced SWAP the model's original rationale/hypothesis for that tick are overwritten in place (haikuResult = {...haikuResult, rationale: "Guardrail override…"}) and are unrecoverable; on any downgraded tick evaluation.symbolOut/symbolIn are nulled, so the proposed symbols survive only in shadowTerminalGates[].proposedAction (shadow path) and, as text, in validationErrors/guardrailOverrides.

Parameter/config snapshot: resolvedAgentManifest (MANIFEST_WRITE_ENABLED=true) freezes at creation the equipped layers (activeRules, bundles, leans, dials, deployedGuardrails, watchlist), an equippedConfigHash, valuesAtLock (archetype, name, preset, riskTolerance, settingsRev) and versionStamps (knobConfigVersionAtLock=2, identityVersionAtLock=2, identityHashAtLock, guardrailSetVersionAtLock=2, promptSpecVersionAtLock=1, gameModePolicy hash…). Numeric knob VALUES (hftConfig, preset levers) are NOT persisted — they are derivable from the version stamps + the code table at that version.

GCS shadow stream (bucket fantasytrades, path shadow/{stream}/{date}/{id}.jsonl) receives fire-and-forget logEvaluation records (decision, symbols, rationale, hypothesis, conviction, triggers, scores, tokenUsage, failureClass) and logDecision at deploy (portfolio, bench, brief, token usage). Writes are best-effort (return false on failure) and require GCS_CREDENTIALS; no prompt, raw text, or model id in these records.
facts.notes: BUILD_RULES §5 records a prior silent multi-week data loss on this stream.

facts.fact: Failed prerequisites / platform-forced attribution are persisted as: evaluation.haikuError{failureClass,message,timestamp,evalId}, cronState.cronErrors[] (cap 20), evaluation.validationErrors[], evaluation.downgraded, evaluation.guardrailOverrides[] (type, symbol, metric, threshold, actual, action, originalDecision, replacementSymbol), statusFeed action/source/triggeredBy vocabulary (risk_manager | guardrail | archetype | haiku | system | tournament_ledger), and trades[].source/exitReason (closed enums).

Decision timestamp granularity: evaluation.timestamp is the ISO instant after the model returned (not the quote fetch instant); trades[].swappedOutAt is the transaction instant; prices used were fetched at tick start (~seconds to a minute earlier). Quote timestamps from EODHD (price.timestamp) are fetched but not persisted.
